title: The 5 most overhyped tech trends of 2026

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: What if the most hyped tech trends of 2026 are more buzz than breakthrough?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Quantum computing is overhyped — current systems are noisy and error-prone, with limited real-world applications.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Neural lace interfaces risk deepening inequality, giving only the wealthy direct brain-computer access.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Researchers are focusing on safety and accessibility, not just speed, to make these tools more inclusive.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: In five years, we may see affordable, ethical neural interfaces that empower all users, not just the privileged few.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future will belong to those who balance ambition with responsibility.

video_cue: A montage of scientists, engineers, and ethicists collaborating in a sleek innovation lab.
